cache: Verified warmup per candidate/workload before alternating measurements; no cache clearing or cold-cache claim.
timing_boundary: First retrieval request through final decode, normalized projection and ordering. Digest/equality and source-boundary checks excluded and separately recorded.
response_bytes: Actual HTTP response body bytes, including JSON-RPC envelopes and overfetch; HTTP/TLS headers excluded; identity encoding.

rpc_paths.address: getaddresstxids(start,end) then getrawtransaction and output-only filtering

prep_path: Adaptive /query with exact fields and matching public filters; one in-flight cursor page.
run_order: Alternating candidate pairs; first candidate switches with workload index and round index.

environment.note: Shared operational stack, not dedicated hardware or equal per-service CPU allocations. Zebra has a larger service allowance; client normalization is included for both.

preparation.source: Direct already-synchronized Zebra RPC; source discovery and full-node initial sync excluded.
preparation.rpc_request_accounting: Not instrumented in this direct timing; no reverse-proxy overhead.
preparation.timer: Native process spawn through observed successful exit; includes fetching, normalization, compression and persistence; archive verification excluded.

earlier_trial.note: Complete preliminary trial retained. Final version enforces absolute response deadlines; same manifest, methods, workers, quotas and repetitions. Address lookup direction changed between trials; no stable ranking is established.
